verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a structured REST v3 API reference (files, permissions and changes resources) and a machine-readable Discovery document, which makes up the reference half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows that the reference is interactive or offers runnable in-page examples. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes returned 404, though the Discovery doc serves as a partial machine-readable substitute. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it explorer, runnable code examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of an interactive reference experience.
